## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs can apply exclusions through the environment.

## Changes
The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that skips matching basenames during archive creation and logs skips at INFO level. It adds parser, file collection, and archive tests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the archive still includes `skip.log` because the parser uses `default=[]`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says every new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment will archive files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions
- cli/main.py:33 — tests — Cover literal exclusions for nested files — The tests leave `--exclude skip.log` against `subdir/skip.log` untested. Every tested exclusion starts with `*`, so it also matches the full path. — A regression to full-path matching could include nested files that users explicitly excluded while the tests still pass. — Fix: Extend `test_main_leaves_excluded_files_out_of_the_archive` with a nested file and a literal basename pattern.
